description.en: Overlapping priority, date and assignee tags leave room for task titles, then spread to the left when a row is hovered or focused.
description.zh: 优先级、日期和负责人标签相互叠放，为任务标题留出空间；悬停或聚焦时向左展开。

keywords: 标签 叠放 展开 任务 列表 元数据 优先级 日期 负责人 hover stacked metadata tags task Gabriel

discovery.caveat: 独立DOM/CSS重建；仅展开本地标签，不连接真实任务服务。

source.implementation: Independent scoped DOM/CSS implementation with a measured analytic damped spring, velocity-preserving interruptions and six framework lifecycle wrappers. No original footage, remote assets or author implementation is distributed.
source.license: Design reference by Gabriel; no author code or redistribution permission is claimed. Independently written DOM/CSS implementation. Lucide icons retain ISC and embedded Inter retains OFL. Original footage and extracted frames stay internal.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Hover a row or focus it to spread its tags. Tap to pin a row; use Up/Down, Home/End to navigate and Escape to collapse.
instructions.zh: 悬停或聚焦一行展开标签，轻触可固定；上下方向键与 Home/End 导航，Escape 收起。
